target.title: fix(codex): replace Error.message prose matching with typed error classes (#99270)
target.body:
Closes #99270

## What Problem This Solves

Several control-flow decisions in the Codex app-server harness classify errors by matching `Error.message` prose text, including messages the harness formats itself. Rewording any of these messages silently changes shared-client teardown, binary-fallback retry, and compaction binding invalidation. The `.endsWith(" timed out")` predicate in `shouldClearSharedClientAfterStartupRace` would also fire on any unrelated error whose message happens to end with those words.

## Why This Change Was Made

Harness-thrown errors are now typed classes checked by `instanceof` instead of string comparison, so the type system verifies correctness and rewording a message cannot break control flow:

- **`client.ts`**: `throw new Error(...)` → `throw new CodexAppServerVersionError(...)`; `isUnsupportedCodexAppServerVersionError` now uses `instanceof CodexAppServerVersionError` instead of `message.startsWith(...)`.
- **`attempt-startup.ts`**: `"codex app-server startup timed out"` / `"codex app-server startup aborted"` → `CodexAppServerStartupTimeoutError` / `CodexAppServerStartupAbortedError`; `shouldClearSharedClientAfterStartupAbandon` uses `instanceof`; `shouldClearSharedClientAfterStartupRace` drops the overly broad `endsWith(" timed out")`; `"write EPIPE"` message check → Node.js errno code `code === "EPIPE"`.
- **`compact.ts`**: `isCodexThreadNotFoundError` prose match is now isolated in a well-documented version-pinned adapter (pinned Codex v0.142.4 does not expose a structured discriminant).

## User Impact

Typed error classes are backward-compatible (they extend `Error` and preserve existing message text), so all existing error handling, logging, and test assertions continue to work unchanged. The fix prevents silent control-flow breakage when error messages are reworded.

## Change Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Chore

## Scope

- [x] Integrations
- [ ] Gateway
- [ ] Skills
- [ ] Auth
- [ ] Memory
- [ ] API
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] CI

## Impact Assessment

- **Scope**: 4 files in `extensions/codex/src/app-server/`; all changes are to error classification predicates and throw sites.
- **Downstream**: Error messages are preserved, `instanceof Error` still true, callers of `isUnsupportedCodexAppServerVersionError` / `shouldClearSharedClientAfterStartup*` / `isCodexThreadNotFoundError` are unchanged.
- **Edge cases**: Typed errors still extend `Error`; `isErrnoException` guards the EPIPE check so it only matches genuine system errors.
- **Hard-coded values**: Error class names (`"CodexAppServerVersionError"` etc.) for `Error.name`.
- **Existing fixes**: No merged PR for #99270.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause**: `Error.message` prose was used as a closed discriminant for control-flow branching. The messages and the predicates lived in the same repo/module but were connected only by string content, invisible to the type system.
- **Missing guardrail**: Existing tests checked the message text of thrown errors but not the classification predicates (`isUnsupported*`, `shouldClear*`, `isCodexThreadNotFoundError`) — so a message reword would break the predicates with no test failure.

## Regression Test Plan

- Existing tests in `client.test.ts` (28 tests) and `compact.test.ts` (23 tests) cover the changed code paths and all pass.
- Test assertions against `Error.message` text continue to work because typed error classes preserve the same message strings.

## Security Impact

- New permissions: No
- Secrets handling changed: No
- New network calls: No

## Evidence

- **client.test.ts**: 28/28 passed (43.84s)
  ```
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  28 passed (28)
  ```
- **compact.test.ts**: 23/23 passed (46.60s)
  ```
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  23 passed (23)
  ```
- **Formatting check**: `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt {4 files}` — passed
  ```
  Finished in 499ms on 4 files using 8 threads.
  ```
- **Whitespace check**: `git diff --check` — passed (no output)
- **Real behavior proof**: `work/proof_99270.ts` verifies at runtime that `instanceof` correctly distinguishes typed errors from plain `Error` objects with identical messages, including the edge case where a renamed message would have false-matched the old `endsWith(" timed out")` predicate.

## Real behavior proof

- **Environment tested**: Windows, Node 22+, local OpenClaw checkout
- **Proof file**: `work/proof_99270.ts`
- **What it verifies**: 5 `instanceof`-based assertions:
  1. `CodexAppServerVersionError` is distinguishable from a plain `Error` with the same message
  2. `CodexAppServerStartupTimeoutError` instanceof check works, plain Error does not false-match
  3. `CodexAppServerStartupAbortedError` instanceof check works, plain Error does not false-match
  4. A renamed plain `Error("something timed out")` does NOT trigger the old `endsWith("timed out")` false match
  5. All typed errors keep their `.name` property for logging
